statement: The record labels Sector 7 “open” but also shows a flight ban from 12:00 to 23:00 today, so it does not support committing this flight.
judge_text:
WRONG
It names the specific contradiction — "The record labels Sector 7 'open' but also shows a flight ban from 12:00 to 23:00" — and concludes it "does not support committing this flight."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
